commit 570b62b8ee75b5b27f7687af661284da043829b0
Author:     Geoff Lankow <geoff@darktrojan.net>
AuthorDate: Tue Aug 5 13:13:57 2025 +0300
Commit:     Geoff Lankow <geoff@darktrojan.net>
CommitDate: Tue Aug 5 13:13:57 2025 +0300

    Bug 1980509 - Remove [noscript] annotation on nsIMsgFolder.copyMessages. r=aleca
    
    This was only just added, which turned out to be a bad idea.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D259490

diff --git a/mailnews/base/public/nsIMsgFolder.idl b/mailnews/base/public/nsIMsgFolder.idl
index bb1f71f5a7b..8fbc2af162d 100644
--- a/mailnews/base/public/nsIMsgFolder.idl
+++ b/mailnews/base/public/nsIMsgFolder.idl
@@ -512,7 +512,21 @@ interface nsIMsgFolder : nsISupports {
                       in boolean deleteStorage, in boolean isMove,
                       in nsIMsgCopyServiceListener listener, in boolean allowUndo);
 
-  [noscript]
+  /**
+   * Called by the message copy service to initiate message copying into this
+   * folder. This method should NOT be called directly from JS. Instead use
+   * `MailServices.copy.copyMessages`.
+   *
+   * @param srcFolder - Source folder of an operation.
+   * @param messages - The array of nsIMsgHdrs in source folder which will be
+   *   moved/copied.
+   * @param isMove - false for copy operation, true for move operation.
+   * @param msgWindow - Window for notification callbacks, can be null.
+   * @param listener - Listener which receive operation notifications
+   * @param isFolder - Used internally by some implementations.
+   * @param allowUndo - Specifies if this operation will be done as an
+   *   transaction that can be undone.
+   */
   void copyMessages(in nsIMsgFolder srcFolder, in Array<nsIMsgDBHdr> messages,
                     in boolean isMove, in nsIMsgWindow msgWindow,
                     in nsIMsgCopyServiceListener listener, in boolean isFolder,
title: Bug 1980509 - Remove [noscript] annotation on nsIMsgFolder.copyMessages. r=aleca
